newsitem.title: USA: Cayman Water board to discuss Argyle bid.
newsitem.headline: Cayman Water board to discuss Argyle bid.

text.p: Cayman Water said on Wednesday it has called a special board meeting to respond to a possible hostile takeover effort by Argyle Partners Ltd.
Cayman said Argyle filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday, requesting permission from the Caymans Islands government to acquire up to 50 percent of Cayman Water.
Argyle currently holds a 9.65 percent stake in Cayman, made up of 283,570 shares bought at prices ranging from $4.68 apiece to $6.29, Cayman said.
Cayman shares were trading on Wednesday at seven, up 3/8 on the day.
Cayman said its board and officers met with Argyle representatives in January and February to hear their proposals, and at that time decided not to support Argyle's effort.
Cayman is based in Georgetown in the Cayman Islands.
